analysis.title: Xylem Inc. (XYL): First Take: 3Q26 revenue below expectations while 2026 guidance lowered
key_insights: XYL 3Q26 revenue was ~$2.20bn, below GSe and FactSet consensus of $2.28bn and below the company's own guide of ~$2.3bn. Organic revenue was flat yoy.
XYL 3Q26 adj. EPS was $1.44 reported, in line with GSe of $1.44 and slightly below consensus of $1.45 per the report's split ($1.44/$1.45).
XYL lowered FY2026 revenue guidance to ~$8.95bn from ~$9.2bn prior, citing lower MCS book-and-ship volumes and slower WSS project ramps. This is below GSe/consensus of $9.23bn/$9.19bn.
XYL cut FY2026 organic growth guidance to flat from +2%-3% prior.
XYL lowered FY2026 adj. EPS guidance to $5.40-$5.45 from $5.55-$5.70, versus GSe and consensus of $5.65.
3Q26 adj. company EBIT margin was 19.4%, above GS's 18.4% estimate, up ~48bps yoy organically per the exhibit.

Measurement & Control Solutions was the main revenue miss: sales of $436mn versus GSe $488mn, down 5% organically, driven by Electric Metering and Analytics. Orders were up 30% yoy organically, with growth across Metering driven by Water and Gas.
Applied Water beat: sales of $489mn versus GSe $462mn, up 9% organically, driven by the Americas. Orders were up 15% yoy, driven by North America Data Centers and Commercial.

Water Infrastructure sales were $645mn, down 1% organically, driven by weakness in Treatment and partly offset by Transport. Orders were down 1% organically. Segment EBIT margin was 23.9%, up ~180bps yoy on productivity and price.

Water Solutions & Services sales were $631mn, down 2% organically, because prior-year one-time Services and Capital work did not repeat. Orders were up 6% yoy, driven by Capital work. Segment margin was 18.1%, down ~190bps yoy.
GS rates XYL Buy with a 12-month price target of $160, based on 17X EV/EBITDA on Q5-Q8 EBITDA. The stock closed at $108.24 on 26 Oct 2026, implying 47.8% upside.

market_movers.rationale: GS keeps its Buy and $160 target after a 3Q26 revenue miss and a guidance cut. Target is based on 17X EV/EBITDA on Q5-Q8 EBITDA, implying 47.8% upside from $108.24.
